track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 5: Basteh-negar
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Basteh-negar in Abu-Ata, Afshari, Bayat-e Tork, Chahargah, Segah, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D3 and dwells most on A in Basteh-negar. The line peaks at B4 (497.4 Hz) at 0:51.9. It closes on the tonic (A3 → Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → E3).
